lines.zh: 我走得很轻，草都没断几根。
lines.en: I walk lightly, and barely a blade of grass breaks.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的雾里，脚步声是我的。
lines.en: In Greckon's mist, the footsteps you hear are mine.

lines.zh: 我绕着你兜圈，看着像在散步。
lines.en: I circle you at a walk, as if out for a stroll.

lines.zh: 风把气味送来，我顺着走。
lines.en: The wind brings a scent, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我的步子很匀，能走一整天。
lines.en: My pace is even; I can keep it for a day.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，是因为我踩在石头上。
lines.en: You cannot hear me because I step on stone.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从这头灌木过去。
lines.en: I lower myself and pass behind this bush.

lines.zh: 一百二十三点命，够我走很远。
lines.en: A hundred twenty-three of life is enough for a long walk.

lines.zh: 我不追直线的东西，我会绕。
lines.en: I do not chase in straight lines; I go around.

lines.zh: 灰白的雾吞了我的影子。
lines.en: The pale mist swallows my shadow.

lines.zh: 我每走十步就停一下，听听。
lines.en: Every ten steps I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 这条小径是我踩出来的。
lines.en: This path exists because I walked it.

lines.zh: 我蹲在雾里，等草重新长直。
lines.en: I crouch in the mist and wait for the grass to straighten.

lines.zh: 安静的林子才藏得住我。
lines.en: Only a quiet wood can hide me.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔指节上的旧血。
lines.en: I lick old blood from my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我在算，你还剩几步路。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 有鸟叫，说明附近没人。
lines.en: Birds are calling, which means no one is near.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转向最响的那边。
lines.en: I turn my ear toward the loudest thing.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道我全记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized every smell in this place.

lines.zh: 我不急着吃，先玩一会。
lines.en: I am in no hurry to eat; first, a little play.

lines.zh: 雾贴着我的背，像件旧披风。
lines.en: Mist clings to my back like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 我数着呼吸声，有一声不是我的。
lines.en: I count breaths, and one of them is not mine.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，游戏就从这里开始。
lines.en: I have seen you, and the game starts here.

lines.zh: 你也看见我了，那就更好了。
lines.en: You saw me too; that is even better.

lines.zh: 我慢慢偏头，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over from head to boot.

lines.zh: 你身上没有伤，很新鲜。
lines.en: You carry no wounds; how fresh.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就知道路在哪。
lines.en: One half-step back and I know your way out.

lines.zh: 我笑了，你看不清，但我在笑。
lines.en: I am smiling; you cannot see it, but I am.

lines.zh: 别做那个动作，我知道你要跑。
lines.en: Do not make that motion; I know you mean to run.

lines.zh: 我盯得比你还久，这局算我赢。
lines.en: I stare longer than you, so this round is mine.

lines.zh: 你手往腰间摸，那里有把刀吧。
lines.en: Your hand drifts to your belt, where a blade waits.

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸了，虽然没用了。
lines.en: I have your face memorized, though it is pointless now.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，血从肩上滴下来。
lines.en: I give half a step and blood drips from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 肋骨断了一根，我照样往前。
lines.en: A rib is broken, and I still push forward.

lines.zh: 你打中了，我要你赔。
lines.en: You landed a hit, and I will collect for it.

lines.zh: 我把这口气咽回去，又笑了。
lines.en: I swallow the breath back and smile again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我收起了玩心。
lines.en: That put an end to my playing.

lines.zh: 我捂着肋，指缝里是热的。
lines.en: I hold my ribs, and my fingers come away warm.

lines.zh: 你比看上去的快一点。
lines.en: You are a little faster than you look.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫会暴露位置。
lines.en: I do not cry out; that would give my position.

lines.zh: 断了两根，还能走。
lines.en: Two are broken, and I can still walk.

lines.zh: 现在开始，我不留手。
lines.en: From now on, I hold nothing back.

lines.zh: 诱饵是给猎物的，我是猎人。
lines.en: Bait is for prey, and I am the hunter.

lines.zh: 你把肉挂在那，我笑了。
lines.en: You hang the meat there, and I laugh.

lines.zh: 我不吃送到手上的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat what is handed to me.

lines.zh: 你的手抖得比肉还香。
lines.en: Your trembling hand smells better than the meat.

lines.zh: 我宁可自己去割，也不要你递。
lines.en: I would rather cut it myself than take your offering.

lines.zh: 这点香味，换不来我的耐心。
lines.en: That little smell will not buy my patience.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，再举一次试试。
lines.en: Step back and try raising it once more.

lines.zh: 我用不着诱饵，你会自己走偏。
lines.en: I need no bait; you will stray on your own.

lines.zh: 收起来，我闻得出铁锈味。
lines.en: Put it away; I can smell the rust on it.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不捡。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not pick things up.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我顺势把你绊了一下。
lines.en: You bumped me, so I tripped you in return.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，是给你留面子。
lines.en: I gave half a step to spare your pride.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，我先站稳了。
lines.en: Bone met bone, and I found my footing first.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，这是我的地盘。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; this is my ground.

lines.zh: 我侧身一让，你就扑空了。
lines.en: I step aside, and your lunge meets nothing.

lines.zh: 你的肩顶过来，我几乎没动。
lines.en: Your shoulder came in, and I hardly moved.

lines.zh: 我推你一下，你就知道轻重了。
lines.en: One push from me and you learn the weight.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，我们只能过去一个。
lines.en: This gap is narrow; only one of us passes.

lines.zh: 你踩我的脚了，那是第二次。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot, and that was the second time.

lines.zh: 我已经数到三，你别再来。
lines.en: I have counted to three; do not do it again.

lines.zh: 狩猎的人身边不该有第二个。
lines.en: A hunter should have no second at his side.

lines.zh: 我不留伴，伴会拖慢脚步。
lines.en: I keep no mate; a mate slows the pace.

lines.zh: 有同类找我，我给了它一条路走。
lines.en: Kin came looking, and I showed it a road out.

lines.zh: 我把窝做在雾最厚的地方，只我一个。
lines.en: I nest where the mist is thickest, alone.

lines.zh: 这林子容不下两副牙。
lines.en: This wood cannot hold two sets of teeth.

lines.zh: 我不繁殖，我只收猎物。
lines.en: I do not breed; I only collect prey.

lines.zh: 成对的事留给吃草的。
lines.en: Pairing off is for the grass-eaters.

lines.zh: 我闻过同类的味，然后绕开了。
lines.en: I smelled my own kind and walked around it.

lines.zh: 冬天我照样一个人过。
lines.en: Winter comes and I pass it alone as usual.

lines.zh: 夜里我谁也不想。
lines.en: At night I miss no one.

lines.zh: 地上那个人掉的刀，我捡了起来。
lines.en: The last one dropped a knife here; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 我把刀在袖子上擦干净，收好。
lines.en: I wipe the blade on my sleeve and keep it.

lines.zh: 这块布不顶用，我扔了。
lines.en: This cloth is useless, so I drop it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西会先闻一闻。
lines.en: I sniff a thing before I take it.

lines.zh: 你的箭我收下了，回头还你。
lines.en: I keep your arrow and will return it later.

lines.zh: 我手里多了一件，就少想一件事。
lines.en: One more thing in hand means one less thought.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币在泥里，我懒得弯腰。
lines.en: A coin lies in the mud, and I will not bend.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进雾里，回头再取。
lines.en: I stash it in the mist and will collect it later.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西都不算战利品。
lines.en: Nothing picked up counts as a trophy.

lines.zh: 我只捡能再用的。
lines.en: I take only what can be used again.

lines.zh: 你在下风口，可惜风向变了。
lines.en: You stood downwind, but the wind has turned.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鼻翼张了一下。
lines.en: I lift my head and my nostrils flare once.

lines.zh: 就你了，别人我看着都太胖。
lines.en: You will do; the others look overfed.

lines.zh: 我踩断一根枝，是故意让你听见。
lines.en: I broke a twig on purpose so you would hear.

lines.zh: 我把刀换到反手，这是习惯。
lines.en: I shift the blade to my back hand out of habit.

lines.zh: 你走出三步，我就知道你的步幅。
lines.en: Three steps and I know your stride.

lines.zh: 我开始跟，从你背后十步开始。
lines.en: I begin trailing you from ten paces behind.

lines.zh: 目标一旦定下，我就不换。
lines.en: Once the mark is set, I do not change it.

lines.zh: 格瑞克的雾里，我嗅到了活气。
lines.en: In Greckon's fog, I caught the smell of something living.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊会把雾喊散。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting thins the mist.

lines.zh: 我舔了下嘴唇，这不算预告。
lines.en: I lick my lips; that is not a warning.

lines.zh: 现在跑，你会跑向我想让你去的方向。
lines.en: Run now, and you will run where I want.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我闭着眼也能扑到。
lines.en: At this range I could pounce with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 我要的不是你的东西，是你。
lines.en: I do not want your belongings; I want you.

lines.zh: 雾里只有你在动，那就够了。
lines.en: Only you move in this fog. That is enough.

lines.zh: 我把刀锋转了个角度，朝你。
lines.en: I turn the blade edge toward you.

lines.zh: 我一直在你侧后方，你没回头。
lines.en: I have stayed at your flank, and you never turned.

lines.zh: 你走快，我也走快，距离不变。
lines.en: You speed up, I speed up, and the gap holds.

lines.zh: 我在等你的脚下一滑。
lines.en: I am waiting for your foot to slip.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和你的叠在一起了。
lines.en: My footsteps have overlapped with yours.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，一、二、三。
lines.en: I count your steps: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 你转弯的时候，我已经在那了。
lines.en: When you turn the corner, I am already there.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，雾替我遮住了。
lines.en: I crouch low, and the mist covers for me.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着两棵树，就这么远。
lines.en: Two trees stand between us, and no more.

lines.zh: 你别停下，停下我就得动手。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop, I must act.

lines.zh: 我很有耐心，这是我这行的手艺。
lines.en: I am patient; that is the craft of my trade.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声是风，不是我。
lines.en: What you heard was wind, not me.

lines.zh: 你的手一直没离开刀柄。
lines.en: Your hand has not left the hilt.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一条已经上钩的线。
lines.en: I watch you like a line already taken.

lines.zh: 再走十步，路就断了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and the path ends.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子，不跟人。
lines.en: I follow your shadow, not you.

lines.zh: 你每回一次头，我就少一步。
lines.en: Every time you look back, I am one step nearer.

lines.zh: 这片雾是我挑的战场。
lines.en: I picked this fog for a reason.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步，但数不准几个。
lines.en: You hear steps, but you cannot count them.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸压在喉咙下面。
lines.en: I keep my breathing low in my throat.

lines.zh: 你走的路，尽头是一面石壁。
lines.en: Your path ends at a stone wall.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切进去，十三点五，刚好。
lines.en: I cut in from the side: thirteen and a half, exactly.

lines.zh: 这一下没让你死，让你记着。
lines.en: This one will not kill you; it will remind you.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖只进去一点，够疼了。
lines.en: My claws go in only a little, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 你转身了，可我更快。
lines.en: You turned around, but I am quicker.

lines.zh: 我打你的膝弯，你就跪下了。
lines.en: I hit behind your knee, and down you go.

lines.zh: 血溅在雾里，红得很显眼。
lines.en: Blood sprays into the mist, red and obvious.

lines.zh: 我不补第二下，除非你还要站。
lines.en: I will not strike twice unless you stand again.

lines.zh: 这一下我收着力，好让你跑。
lines.en: I held back on that one, so you could run.

lines.zh: 你护住了胸口，护不住脖子。
lines.en: You guard your chest and leave your throat.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，你才刚抬手。
lines.en: I land before your hand comes up.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡住了爪，挡不住力。
lines.en: Your armor stops the claw and not the force.

lines.zh: 我打完退了两步，看你倒。
lines.en: I step back two paces to watch you fall.

lines.zh: 这就是我全部的手艺，一次。
lines.en: That is my whole craft, delivered once.

lines.zh: 你还能站着，我有点失望。
lines.en: You are still standing, and I am disappointed.

lines.zh: 我从雾里出来，你才看清刀。
lines.en: I step out of the fog, and only then do you see the blade.

lines.zh: 这一刀划在你的护腕上。
lines.en: The blade catches your bracer.

lines.zh: 我打在你肩膀，先让你慌。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder, to make you panic first.

lines.zh: 十三点五，一分不多。
lines.en: Thirteen and a half. Not a point more.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就跟上来补第二下。
lines.en: You back away, and I follow with the second.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的刀，你拔不出来了。
lines.en: I pin your blade. It is not coming free.

lines.zh: 雾散了一小块，我就在那儿。
lines.en: A patch of mist clears, and there I am.

lines.zh: 格瑞克多了一个会走的东西。
lines.en: Greckon gains one more thing that walks.

lines.zh: 我从树根下站起来，抖掉身上的土。
lines.en: I rise from the roots and shake off the soil.

lines.zh: 这地方本来就该有我。
lines.en: This place was always meant to have me.

lines.zh: 我睁眼第一件事是找路，不是找食。
lines.en: I wake looking for a path, not for food.

lines.zh: 石头上留下一串爪印，从无到有。
lines.en: A line of claw marks appears on the stone.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口冷雾，肺里发疼。
lines.en: I breathe cold mist and my lungs ache.

lines.zh: 生成的动静很小，只有风听见。
lines.en: My arrival is quiet; only the wind hears it.

lines.zh: 我在林间空地站了一会，才动。
lines.en: I stand a while in the clearing before moving.

lines.zh: 这片雾归我走了。
lines.en: This mist is mine to walk.

lines.zh: 我出现时，附近的虫子全停了。
lines.en: When I appear, the insects all go still.

lines.zh: 我来了，猎物们该换地方了。
lines.en: I am here, so the prey should move along.

lines.zh: 火苗顺着袖子爬，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flame climbs my sleeve, and I beat it twice.

lines.zh: 从树冠摔下来，脚踝先响。
lines.en: Falling from the canopy, my ankle cracks first.

lines.zh: 我这张脸埋进水里，很陌生。
lines.en: My face goes under, and it feels unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 炸开的土把我掀进了灌木。
lines.en: Blast-thrown soil dumps me into the shrubs.

lines.zh: 箭扎进大腿，我把它拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my thigh, and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 那道光烧得皮下发烫。
lines.en: That light leaves a heat beneath my skin.

lines.zh: 三天没吃到活的，手开始抖。
lines.en: Three days without live prey, and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在我藏身的树上，耳鸣到现在。
lines.en: Lightning hit my tree, and my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，雾也没了。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and so is the mist.
